summary: Built sorry-free infrastructure for K=0 zone-3 transfer in WitnessCount.lean. Four key theorems proved sorry-free: temporal_truth_transfer, depth2_quant_transfer, nf_depth0_char_operator_depth, nf_depth0_char_iff_eval. Zone-3 main path (y1<x' or y2>t') is sorry-free. Edge case (y1>=x' AND y2<=t') remains sorry. PriorComposition.lean sorry sites at lines 869/964 NOT yet resolved.

sorry_inventory.assumption: When F(P_w) witness y1 >= x' AND S(P_w) witness y2 <= t', there exists w' in (t', x') with nf_w0
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Requires combined 3-variable reasoning. Single-endpoint depth-2 temporal transfers produce witnesses that may both fall outside (t', x'). The edge case may be impossible on Prior structures but proving it requires either: (a) a formula of operator_depth <= 2 encoding the interval constraint, (b) proof via depth-1 quantifier conditions + HasAttainedINF first-x-type argument showing the case is impossible, or (c) the witness-count induction approach from Rabinovich Lemma 5.3.
sorry_inventory.next_dispatch: Research: formalize the impossibility of the edge case via the argument that in M, the depth-1 profile at [w,t] encodes 'no x-type between t and w' when true, and after transfer to [w1,t'] in N, HasAttainedINF first x-type r0 between t' and w1 contradicts 'no x-type between t' and w1' when w1 >= r0 > t'. This forces w1 < r0 <= x', giving w1 in (t', x'). When nf_w0 = x-type, w is itself x-type so the first x-type above t in M is <= w < x, which means the depth-2 quantifier condition correctly records this and forces the transferred witness below x'.
